title: Cross-implementation interoperability
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, 13. Reference script; Stakeholder directive: Kotlin library first, Rust library second.

statements.label: Cross-implementation interoperability
statements.requirement: Certificates issued by each library (ES256 and PS256) SHALL verify in the other library and in the smart-trust reference script's verify routine. Certificates issued by the reference script SHALL verify in both libraries.
